lines.zh: 我迈着沉步子走过浅滩。
lines.en: I walk the shallows with heavy steps.
Each step sends water splashing.
I walk along the riverbank.
I carry my belly out in front.
I step slowly over a stone.
I head for deeper water.
I sway with each step, yet hold steady.
My gills open and close.

lines.zh: 我朝有鱼腥味的方向走。
lines.en: I walk toward the smell of fish.
I pass beside the reeds.
I stop again to breathe.
I head for that mudflat.
I squat with my gills working.
I rest a hand on my belly.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地听着水声。
lines.en: I listen to the water without moving.
My breath is heavy.
I watch the river a while.

lines.zh: 我把身子慢慢转了半圈。
lines.en: I turn my body slowly half around.
I scratch at my own neck.
I have not shifted by a hair.
A boat sounds in the distance.
I let out a great big yawn.
I press my feet into the mud.
I squat a little lower.
I lift my face and squint.
I wait, unhurried.
I turn my face to you.
You speak first.
I look you over head to foot.
Do you smell of fish?
I step out one pace.

lines.zh: 你这么站着，倒有点意思。
lines.en: Standing like that is rather interesting.
I raise my right palm.
I nod to you once.
Your hands are in your sleeves.
I dislike being looked up and down.
I settle back down.
Stay if you wish.
I lift my chin and look at you.
I look past you.
I put my hands behind my back.
There is mud on your boots.
I grunt and take a step back.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我皮上一道。
lines.en: That left a line on my hide.
I press the wound.
My gills work faster.

lines.zh: 我把身架一点一点立稳。
lines.en: I bring my frame upright bit by bit.
It hurts, and I can still stand.
I retreat toward the water.
My breathing has turned heavy.
I keep that on my thick hide.
I raise a hand to guard.
That smells of the sea.
I ease over to it.
I swallow it in one go.
This smells strong.
I look for more.
I eat with dignity.
When done I wipe my mouth.
I accept the whole plate.
I chew it a little at a time.
Give more and I will want more.
This beats the river fish.
I roll up my sleeve first.
I am knocked back half a step.
I am heavy; I will not be shoved.
I turn slightly aside.
You are far too near.
One lift of my palm blocks it.
I look down at you.
I shift aside.
This crowded, I cannot turn.
I dislike being knocked about.
I plant myself.
I am the head of this stretch.
I have little interest in that.
I squat and do not move.
I turn my face to the river.
I rock my head from side to side.
I do fine on my own.
I have much to do.
I shift toward the water.
I do not speak of that.
I keep squatting.
I snatch it up in one hand.
I glance at it and toss it.
This one is too light.
I tuck it into my sleeve.
I swallow it down.
This is worth not a coin.
I toss it back into the water.
I weigh it in my hand.
Keep it; it may serve.
I carry it a few paces.
Something shifts under the surface.
I turn my face that way.
I pin it dead centre of my eye.
I rise up slowly.
I walk toward the bank.
It is too near my water.
I bring my hand up in front.
My stance is set.
I start toward it.
I bellow at it once.

lines.zh: 我不允许有人动我的水。
lines.en: No one touches my water.

lines.zh: 我朝它的方向伸了伸脖子。
lines.en: I stretch my neck its way.
My front stays on it.
It shifts and I shift.
I move toward it step by step.
It has backed to the waterline.
I am in no rush at all.
I open my hand.
It is close to the water now.
I close by one notch.
My shadow lies on it.
It is panicking inside.
I do not give up one step.
I have blocked its way.
I bring my palm down.
I sweep my hand across.
That knocks it over.
I seize it and fling it away.
It cuts me and my hide holds.
I strike once more.
I drive it into the mud.
It retreats and I hold.

lines.zh: 我把手在衣襟上擦了擦。
lines.en: I wipe my hand on my coat.
Enough of this.
I knock it into the shallows.
I press it down with my weight.
I straighten up out of the water.

lines.zh: 水顺着我的身子流下去。
lines.en: Water runs down my body.
This is where river meets sea.
I look all the way around first.
I shift two steps onto the bank.
I flare my gills and take a breath.
I settle slowly down.
It is eerily quiet around here.
I wait for someone to pass.
I settle my sleeves.

lines.zh: 我朝河水的方向看了一眼。
lines.en: I glance toward the river.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的皮，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire sears my hide and I slap it out.
On landing my whole bulk drops.

lines.zh: 水灌进腮里，我拼命抬头。
lines.en: Water floods my gills and I strain my head up.
The blast drives me backward.
Something buries itself in my shoulder.
An art binds me and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到海鲜，我没劲了。
lines.en: Too long without seafood and my strength is gone.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的皮走，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning runs over my hide and I lock up.
No water and no ground under me.
